title: An initial pension choice
hook: Two stated cases: explore the composition of active and default choices.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the composition of active and default choices affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Final, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the composition of active and default choices in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

provenance.sourceEntryOriginal: - **80.** In Sweden's 2000 pension reform about two-thirds actively picked funds; within a few years under 10% of new entrants did, and the default fund outperformed the average chosen portfolio (Cronqvist & Thaler, 2004).
